summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release. The release reported total revenue growth of 2% YoY, with Baidu Core AI-powered Business revenue exceeding RMB 13.6 billion, up 49% YoY. Non-GAAP operating income was RMB 4.0 billion. The company returned US$172 million to shareholders via share repurchases in Q1. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or special situation is announced. The filing is a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer.
